summary:
高质量16:9横版二维手绘动画MV。同一对兄妹的五张温馨合影依次展示春、夏、秋、冬和在家过年。使用VTuber、Galgame事件CG和Vocaloid手书MV风格的圆角相框、贴纸遮罩、错位纸层、手绘光线与节拍形变完成可爱而新颖的连续转场。

retention_analysis:
妹妹的脸、发型、配色和比例完全保留，服装随季节自然变化；
哥哥的脸、黑色头发和整体形象在五个场景中保持一致；
五个场景保持统一的二维手绘线条、平涂上色和马卡龙色彩；
音频完整复制，不改变演唱和节拍。

detailed_description:

高质量二维手绘手书动画，16:9横版，Vocaloid动画MV与Galgame事件CG风格。统一使用细腻手绘线条、平面赛璐璐上色、柔和纸张纹理、粉蓝、蜜桃粉、薄荷绿、杏橙和奶白色。禁止3D渲染、写实摄影、畸形肢体、错误手指、崩坏五官、水印、Logo和闪烁频闪。

必须按照春、夏、秋、冬、过年的顺序完整展示五个独立场景，禁止省略、合并、重复或交换顺序。每次转场在指定时间点开始，并在0.20至0.25秒内完整结束。

五个场景之间禁止硬切、黑帧、白闪和普通淡入淡出。转场采用二维图形化动画：圆角照片卡片、贴纸形遮罩、手绘光线、错位纸层、网点、星星、圆点、丝带与花形图案随音乐节拍滑动、旋转和重组。禁止老套的物体直接放大遮满镜头，不出现软件界面、按钮或节点。

全片采用自然抓拍感：兄妹不看镜头、不刻意摆姿势，不做剪刀手、挥手或其他固定手势。所有画面只能出现同一位妹妹和同一位哥哥，禁止第三人、路人、人群、陌生面孔、背景人物和人形剪影。转场过程中兄妹的脸和身体不得变形、融合、复制或互换。


[Shot 1] <d>[Japanese]何千回も 塗り替えた思い出</d>，日文粉色字幕出现在视频正下方。春季手绘事件CG铺满画面。粉蓝天空和奶白云朵下盛开樱花，妹妹抬头接住飘落的花瓣，哥哥自然地替她拂去头发上的一片樱花，两人相视微笑。画面带轻微二维多层视差，花瓣缓慢移动。

[Shot 2] At 00:01.100 <d>[Japanese]何千回も 塗り替えた思い出</d>，日文粉色字幕出现在视频正下方。杏橙色手绘光线沿樱花飘落轨迹快速描出一个圆角相框，花瓣依次变成粉蓝星星贴纸与透明圆点。春季画面分成两张略微错位的二维照片卡片，卡片沿斜向轻快滑开；卡片间隙中的粉蓝色逐渐变成夏季天空，圆点变成海面反光和透明泡泡，完整显现夏季海边颗粒胶片合影。转场像Galgame事件CG解锁动画，全程无硬切。

蓝天与闪光海面前，哥哥把一支冰棒递给妹妹，妹妹笑着接过，两人并肩坐在堤岸上看向海面。圆角胶片边框轻微漂浮，背景泡泡缓慢上升。

[Shot 3] At 00:02.200 <d>[Japanese]何千回も 塗り替えた思い出</d>，日文粉色字幕出现在视频正下方。海面的三道蓝色波纹被压缩成薄荷绿、杏橙和金黄色的手绘丝带。丝带沿节拍交错穿过画面，透明泡泡变成大小不同的网点和圆形贴纸；三条丝带在中央轻轻打结后向两侧展开，露出下方层叠的秋季纸张拼贴。蓝色调连续变成金黄与枫叶红，全程保持二维平面动画质感。

金黄色银杏和红色枫叶铺满背景，风吹乱妹妹的围巾，哥哥自然地伸手替她整理；妹妹抬头看他，两人同时笑起来。纸张边缘、圆点和细小星形贴纸随音乐轻微错位移动。

[Shot 4] At 00:03.300 <d>[Japanese]何千回も 塗り替えた思い出</d>，日文粉色字幕出现在视频正下方。一片红色枫叶在前景分裂成四个扁平贴纸形叶片，四片叶子围绕画面中心组成花形徽章。徽章旋转四分之一圈，暖色纸层产生短暂的手绘拖影；叶脉随即变成冰蓝色六角线条，花形徽章完整重组为雪花遮罩。雪花遮罩从中央向外展开，连续显现冬季户外拍立得，过程无白闪、无硬切。

积雪覆盖安静的公园，兄妹穿着保暖冬装。妹妹踩进松软积雪时轻微失去平衡，哥哥立即扶住她的手臂；两人站稳后相视大笑。背景只有缓慢飘落的手绘雪点和奶白色圆形贴纸。

[Shot 5] At 00:04.400 <d>[Japanese]何千回も 塗り替えた思い出</d>，日文粉色字幕出现在视频正下方。妹妹脚边的一颗小雪球弹起并分解成十二个奶白色圆点贴纸，圆点沿圆弧排列成可爱的花边图案。杏橙与蜜桃粉手绘光线依次连接圆点，描出一个带蝴蝶结角标的圆角事件CG相框。相框内部的冬季蓝色以错位纸层方式向四周滑开，底层色彩从冰蓝连续变成奶黄、蜜桃粉和新年红，平滑显现在家过年的温暖场景。雪球不变成饺子，也不直接放大遮挡镜头。

屋内亮着奶黄色灯光，窗外持续下雪；背景有红灯笼、无文字窗花和小型星星贴纸，桌上摆着饺子、橘子和无文字红色红包。房间里只有兄妹两人。两人坐在桌边一起包饺子，哥哥把一个形状歪斜的饺子放到妹妹面前，妹妹忍不住笑，他也跟着笑。圆角相框边缘出现轻微杏橙色手绘光流，尾帧保持兄妹低头继续包饺子的自然瞬间。

不增加风声、海浪声、脚步声、室内声、笑声、转场声或其他音效。

<Audio 1>原唱和完整BGM直接复用，禁止重新演唱、变速、变调、混音、裁剪或增加任何声音。

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] High-quality two-second 16:9 Japanese 2D hand-drawn anime-opening closing animation. The entire video is one continuous shot with no reference images, no hard cut, no black frame, and no visible edit point.

The opening shows an abstract cobalt-blue summer sky above a narrow sparkling sea horizon. Rows of translucent pastel-blue circular masks drift gently upward, revealing fragments of cyan sky, soft white clouds, and reflected sea light. Use clean cel-animation shapes, flat graphic layers, soft pastel colors, and a polished Vocaloid hand-drawn MV atmosphere. No people or character silhouettes appear.

The exact vertical Japanese lyric "繋いでく" is the main lyric text. It appears from the first frame in the right-center area as a single fixed vertical column. All four characters appear simultaneously in this exact top-to-bottom order:

繋
い
で
く

Use a standard Japanese sans-serif font with medium weight and normal proportions. Color the upper character pale cyan and gradually transition toward pale pink on the lower character. Use no outline, shadow, glow, background panel, sticker border, handwriting effect, or three-dimensional styling. The four characters remain sharp, stable, and unchanged through the final frame. Do not reveal them one by one.

When <Audio 1> reaches <d>[Japanese] 繋いでく</d>, synchronize the audible lyric with the already-visible vertical text. At 00:00.250, a narrow apricot-orange light leak sweeps diagonally from the lower left toward the upper right. A restrained rainbow refraction briefly tints the circular-mask edges pale pink and warm cream. The vertical lyric remains on the topmost layer and is never covered.

At 00:00.550, the circular masks smoothly expand and turn warm white. The blue summer background rapidly becomes brighter, producing a soft controlled anime-style overexposure without a sudden white flash.

At 00:00.850, the enlarged circles completely cover the summer background and merge into a clean warm-white OP closing card. A thin cyan horizontal line draws from the left edge toward the right side. Near the right side, a thin vertical accent line grows downward, changing from cyan at the top to pale pink at the bottom. Add two small blue-and-pink circular accents near the line intersection.

At 00:00.900, five lines of production information appear simultaneously in the upper-left area of the warm-white closing card. They remain completely fixed and clearly readable through 00:02.000.

Display exactly these five horizontal lines, preserving every character, capital letter, number, punctuation mark, and space:

"制作：蝉声撩雪风/bilibili"
"Music：SUNO 5.5"
"Video：MiniMax H3"
"Workflow：ComfyUI"
"全編ノーカット・90秒ワンパス生成"

Each credit must occupy one separate horizontal line. Keep all five lines left-aligned with even vertical spacing. Do not wrap, merge, omit, repeat, translate, abbreviate, or rearrange any line. Use a clean Japanese sans-serif font with regular weight, medium-small size, muted blue color, no outline, no shadow, no glow, and no decorative frame. The fifth line may be slightly smaller so it remains on one complete line.

From 00:01.100 to 00:02.000, hold the completed closing card nearly still. The final composition contains:

- The five exact production-information lines in the upper-left area.
- The exact vertical lyric "繋いでく" in the right-center area.
- One thin cyan horizontal line.
- One cyan-to-pink vertical accent line.
- Two small blue-and-pink circular accents.

These are the only visible text elements allowed in the entire video. Do not generate a song title, additional credits, company names, dates, signatures, logos, watermarks, pseudo-text, random Japanese characters, or unreadable glyphs.

Prohibit 3D rendering, photorealism, characters, excessive bloom, violent white flashing, frequency flicker, hearts, stickers, full-screen decorative borders, and cluttered graphics. End exactly at 00:02.000 on the complete closing card without fading to black.
